recipe.visualDefinition: A mid-century modern album cover featuring a light grey background with a large cyan blue geometric block containing a halftone portrait and left-aligned typography. The layout uses thick horizontal rules and a slight diagonal tilt for the lower graphic element.
coreVisualRelationships: Cyan blue block acts as a container for both text and image
Thick horizontal rules separate the primary display text
Monochromatic halftone portrait provides a textural contrast to flat color fields
Asymmetrical balance between the heavy top text and the tilted bottom container

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Portrait positioned in the bottom right quadrant, framed within a cyan block.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large cyan blue block containing the tracklist and portrait.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Top-down reading from the large display name, through the title, down to the tracklist, ending at the portrait.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample light grey margins at the top and sides create a clean, modern feel.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Cyan Blue (Graphic Blocks and Display Text)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation cyan against a low-saturation neutral grey.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Extremely tight tracking for display text
Horizontal bars integrated into the layout grid
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy geometric sans for headers paired with a more legible, slightly softer sans for lists.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the weight and mid-century feel of the display text.
Provides the clean, Swiss-style legibility for the tracklist.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a light grey background. In the center, place two thick cyan horizontal bars. Below them, place a large cyan rectangle tilted approximately 3 degrees counter-clockwise. Inside the right half of this rectangle, place a black and white halftone portrait of a man singing with eyes closed.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the artist name in large cyan extra-bold sans-serif above the first bar. Add the album title in the same style between the two bars. Inside the tilted cyan rectangle on the left, add a list of song titles in white bold sans-serif, aligned to the left.

verificationChecks: Is the background a consistent light grey?
Is the cyan color vibrant and flat?
Is the bottom block tilted slightly?
Is the portrait rendered in a high-contrast halftone style?

adjustableVariables: Tilt angle of the bottom block
Halftone dot size for the portrait

mustAchieve: High contrast between cyan and white text

postGenerationChecks: Ensure all text is legible against the cyan background.
Check that the horizontal rules are perfectly parallel.
Verify the halftone effect doesn't obscure facial features.
Confirm the grey background has no color cast.
recipe.reuseFormula: Light Grey Base + Cyan Geometric Overlays + Heavy Sans-Serif + Halftone Portrait = Mid-Century Soul Aesthetic
